decisions.reason: As a specialist naval line with long qualification and procurement cycles that fits our robust application-specific strengths, we would keep the option open while commercial potential continues to unfold.
The desk lamp remains more peripheral and exposed to competition than our core project business, but it still complements ergonomic office applications and is worth retaining until demand is clearer.

Because this pendant luminaire is a flagship product closely aligned with our strategic move toward efficient, high-quality application lighting, we would strongly favor keeping it absent clearly poor results.

After two years, the marine HMI searchlight looks too narrow and too weakly aligned with our LED-focused direction for the value of keeping the option open to outweigh the benefit of reallocating resources.

Marine searchlights continue to match our specialist transport and rugged-lighting capabilities, so we would retain the line while its niche demand remains credible and the holding cost appears manageable.
